cohort: 150 women (75 in the ARM group and 75 in the SRM group) experiencing progression of labor at term, with the majority aged 25-30 years.
finding: Amniotomy significantly shortened the duration of the first stage of labor by 46 minutes.
mod_finding: The amniotomy group had a slightly higher, but statistically not significant, risk of Caesarean section compared to the spontaneous rupture of membranes group.
